actions.ts.reason: Candidate action writes require authenticated workspace membership through requireWorkspaceUser.

ai-summary.ts.reason: Candidate-facing AI summary access is intentionally reachable without workspace login.

auth.ts.reason: Authentication entrypoints must remain reachable before a user session exists.

blocks.ts.reason: Candidate block reads and writes are scoped to authenticated workspace users.

candidate-status.ts.reason: Candidate status mutations require authenticated workspace membership while candidate appeal remains a candidate-facing path.

config.ts.reason: Runtime configuration reads and writes are admin-only through getAdminAccessError checks.

filter-presets.ts.reason: Filter preset administration is guarded by getAdminAccessError checks.

health.ts.reason: Health check endpoints are intentionally unauthenticated for uptime probes.

industry.ts.reason: Industry taxonomy lookup data is public product metadata.

job-descriptions.ts.reason: Job description operations are guarded by getAdminAccessError checks.

notifications.ts.reason: Notification administration uses route-level requireAdmin middleware.

public-shares.ts.reason: Public share creation requires the resume:share:public:create workspace permission; anonymous reads resolve only through hash-backed public tokens.

resume-submit.ts.reason: Candidate resume submission is externally reachable and uses its own submission token authorization.

resumes.ts.reason: Resume analysis, audit, reingest, and reset operations use requireAdmin middleware.

resumes_admin.ts.reason: Resume admin operations use per-route requireAdmin middleware.

admin_users.ts.reason: Admin password reset uses requireAdmin middleware plus an inline dev-workspace check.

resumes_diagnostics.ts.reason: Resume diagnostic routes use requireAdmin middleware.

resumes_import.ts.reason: Resume import, backup, and reset routes use requireAdmin middleware.

resumes_match.ts.reason: Resume matching reads and run mutation paths require authenticated workspace membership through requireWorkspaceUser.

resumes_packets.ts.reason: Review packet and learning feedback operations use requireAdmin middleware.

resumes_search.ts.reason: The operational resume list route uses workspace permission checks so hr can grant anonymous/everyone resume:search while operational overlays stay authenticated.

rss.ts.reason: RSS routes expose public feed data.

scoring-evaluation.ts.reason: Scoring reports and tuning/rollback operations require authenticated workspace membership through requireWorkspaceUser.

search-alerts.ts.reason: Search alert reads and mutations require authenticated workspace membership through requireWorkspaceUser.

search-analytics.ts.reason: Search analytics accepts client telemetry rather than workspace membership-gated operational writes.

search-profiles.ts.reason: Search profile administration uses requireAdmin middleware.

search.ts.reason: News search endpoints expose public product search data.

sessions.ts.reason: Session reads and mutations require authenticated workspace membership through requireWorkspaceUser.

summaries.ts.reason: Summary administration and runtime configuration use getAdminAccessError checks.

topics.ts.reason: Topic routes expose public product data.

trends.ts.reason: Trend routes expose public product data.

web-vitals.ts.reason: Web vitals accepts client performance telemetry.

worker.ts.reason: Worker proxy routes use the worker service's own authorization path.
